All tests pass. I implemented the duplicate item endpoint with the following changes:

**Backend Implementation (backend/app/api/routes/items.py):**
- Added `POST /items/{id}/duplicate` endpoint that:
  - Fetches the item by ID
  - Verifies the current user is the owner or a superuser (same permission model as other endpoints)
  - Creates a new Item with the same title and description
  - Sets the new item's owner to the current user
  - Returns the duplicated ItemPublic object

**Tests (backend/tests/api/routes/test_items.py):**
- Added `test_duplicate_item`: Verifies the endpoint creates a copy with same content but new ID, owned by the current user
- Added `test_duplicate_item_not_found`: Verifies 404 when duplicating non-existent item
- Added `test_duplicate_item_not_enough_permissions`: Verifies 403 when user tries to duplicate another user's item
